name: Word
description: Builds polished, professional .docx documents -- proper headings, tables, lists, and page setup for reports, letters, memos, and templates.
author: Siduslabs
readme:
# Word Skill

Turns your notes, data, or draft into a polished, professional .docx -- proper headings, tables, TOC, and page setup done right, built with docx-js.

## What it does
- Uses real heading styles so navigation, TOCs, and document structure actually work
- Sets up proper page size, margins, headers, and footers instead of leaving library defaults in place
- Handles tracked changes and comments correctly, with every edit properly wrapped and attributed
- Avoids the common docx-js footguns -- table width, list bullets, page breaks, dot-leaders
- Renders every page to an image and checks for overflow, bad breaks, and leftover placeholder text before calling it done

## Try it
- "write this up as a Word doc"
- "turn my notes into a formal report"
- "add tracked changes for this edit"

Works from a blank prompt or an existing .docx/.dotx template.
